description: This file contains server-side code-behind logic for the ShowAns page in an online examination system. It handles loading answers for questions, updating marks, and navigation controls, interacting with a SQL Server database to retrieve and update student answers and related data.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page, derived from System.Web.UI.Page, handling page load events and button clicks related to displaying and submitting answers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves student answers from the database for questions 1-5 and populates UI controls. Checks user session validity.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Processes the submission of marks entered by the admin, updates database records for theoryAns and queue tables, and navigates to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to LoginPage.aspx.
